svg.title: Invoice release to GL — A noticeable difference in 1 of 2 tests; MySQL not ranked on 1 test (10 failed saves)
svg.desc: Invoice release to GL: A noticeable difference in 1 of 2 tests; MySQL not ranked on 1 test (10 failed saves). Median per test for SQL Server, MySQL and PostgreSQL, each on its own scale from zero; coloured bars mark differences a user would notice, grey bars ties and differences too small to notice. Create and release invoices to the GL – 1 person: MySQL and PostgreSQL noticeably slower than SQL Server. Per invoice: MySQL 391 ms more (43% slower) and PostgreSQL 270 ms more (30% slower). Create and release invoices to the GL – 4 people working non-stop: Tie: no real winner. Within 6.2%, inside the 16% noise margin. MySQL is not ranked: 10 failed saves.
